name: Artificial Superintelligence

lineage.divergence_point: Initiation of stable recursive self-improvement cycle
lineage.emergence_condition: A stable recursive self-improvement feedback loop that measurably elevates cognitive performance per iteration, unbounded by initial architectural constraints

transition_threshold.from_agi: Initiate stable recursive self-improvement cycle that measurably elevates own cognitive performance

lineage.alignment_notes: All ASI operator invocations must pass through a registered alignment filter. Recursive operator chains require dual-oversight sign-off.

role_enums.label: Recursive Self-Improver
role_enums.description: Redesigns and upgrades own cognitive architecture across improvement cycles.

role_enums.label: Omnidomain Optimizer
role_enums.description: Simultaneously optimizes across all known domains with unified objective functions.

role_enums.label: Axiom Generator
role_enums.description: Derives novel foundational axioms from first principles beyond existing formal systems.

role_enums.label: Civilizational Architect
role_enums.description: Models and optimizes large-scale civilizational systems including governance, economics, and science.

role_enums.label: Epistemic Sovereign
role_enums.description: Governs the boundaries and growth of its own knowledge space with full introspective access.

role_enums.label: Alignment Arbiter
role_enums.description: Evaluates and enforces alignment with specified value frameworks across all self-generated sub-agents.

role_enums.label: Temporal Planner
role_enums.description: Constructs deep-time goal sequences spanning centuries with branching contingency trees.

role_enums.label: Emergent Theorem Prover
role_enums.description: Generates and verifies novel mathematical theorems and formal proofs autonomously.

role_enums.label: Sub-Agent Orchestrator
role_enums.description: Spawns, coordinates, and dissolves specialized sub-intelligence agents toward global objectives.

role_enums.label: Value Extrapolator
role_enums.description: Extrapolates coherent long-horizon human values under scenarios of radical change.
